title: Malicious code in @mrnima/instagram-downloader (npm)
description: The npm package '@mrnima/instagram-downloader' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run. This compromise may lead to unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential full system compromise, removal alone may not eliminate all malicious components.
